headline.bm: Washington dan Doha menimbang perjanjian Hormuz yang dilaporkan (pelepasan dana AS$8 bilion bagi pembukaan semula pelayaran, belum disahkan) ketika Trump mengisyaratkan sikap berhati-hati dan minyak reda hampir AS$98; Demokrat bersiap melancarkan siasatan selepas pilihan raya separuh penggal. Di Malaysia, tahanan rumah Najib masih tertangguh, amaran banjir dan hujan berterusan, dan Melaka mengundi 14 Nov.
headline.en: Washington and Doha weigh a reported Hormuz deal (an $8bn funds release for reopened shipping, unconfirmed) while Trump signals restraint and oil eases near $98; Democrats prepare probes after the midterms. In Malaysia, Najib's house arrest remains on hold, floods and rain alerts continue, and Melaka votes on Nov 14.

summary.bm: Jabatan Peguam Negara menafikan mengingkari titah Agong dan mahu penjelasan tempoh penjara; Peguam Negara memohon menghadap Baginda. Pemimpin Umno, serta Umno dan Pas di Kelantan, membuat laporan polis, peguam Najib mahu beliau dipindahkan pulang segera dan Istana Negara menegaskan titah itu jelas. Peletakan jawatan Anthony Loke masih bergantung pada ketibaan Najib di rumah. Asyraf Wajdi (Umno) berkata tiada keperluan mengarahkan Peguam Negara menghadap Agong. Pemuda Umno Johor menggesa Peguam Negara berundur kerana pengendalian isu ini.
summary.en: The AG's Chambers denies defying the King's decree and seeks clarity on jail terms; the AG is seeking an audience with the King. Umno leaders, and Umno and PAS in Kelantan, lodged police reports, Najib's lawyers want him moved home now, and Istana Negara says the decree is clear. Loke's resignation as Transport Minister remains tied to Najib arriving home. Umno's Asyraf Wajdi says there is no need to direct the AG to see the King. Johor Umno Youth has called for the Attorney General to step down over the handling.

title.bm: AG mohon menghadap Agong ketika tahanan rumah Najib tertangguh; Umno buat laporan polis
title.en: AG seeks audience with the King as Najib's house arrest stays on hold; Umno lodges police reports

why.bm: Menekan gabungan kerajaan, Umno dan peranan istana enam hari sebelum PRN Melaka.
why.en: Puts the Madani coalition, Umno and the palace's role under strain six days before the Melaka polls.

summary.bm: BN dan PN melancarkan manifesto bersama di MITC pada 6 Nov untuk negeri berpenduduk kira-kira 1.06 juta, dan Setiausaha Agung PN Takiyuddin berkata isu tahanan rumah tidak menjejaskan kerjasama itu. Pengerusi Pakatan Melaka berkata kerjasama BN-PN mungkin tidak bertukar menjadi sokongan pengundi sepenuhnya. Pengundian Sarawak ditetapkan 12 Dis dengan penamaan calon 28 Nov.
summary.en: BN and PN launched a joint manifesto at MITC on Nov 6 for a state of about 1.06 million people, and PN's Takiyuddin says the house-arrest issue will not hurt the pact. Melaka's Pakatan chairman says BN-PN cooperation may not translate into full voter support. Sarawak polling is set for Dec 12 with nomination on Nov 28.

title.bm: PRN Melaka 14 Nov: kerjasama BN-PN diuji ketika isu Najib berlarutan; Sarawak mengundi 12 Dis
title.en: Melaka polls on Nov 14: BN-PN pact tested while Najib issue lingers; Sarawak votes Dec 12

why.bm: Ujian penting bagi gabungan menjelang PRU16.
why.en: A key test for the coalitions ahead of GE16.

summary.bm: MKN menyatakan keadaan keselamatan siber negara terkawal dengan tahap ancaman sederhana, manakala NACSA mencatat insiden melibatkan beberapa institusi kewangan. Fahmi berkata cubaan itu tidak menyebabkan kecurian data atau gangguan perbankan, dan Kabinet meminta semakan lebih mendalam ke atas aset kerajaan, bank dan GLC. Menteri Pertanian Mohamad Sabu berkata tiada arahan menyimpan stok makanan dan menggesa orang ramai bertenang.
summary.en: MKN says the national cybersecurity situation is under control with the threat level at moderate, while NACSA has noted incidents involving several financial institutions. Fahmi says the attempts caused no data theft or banking disruption, and Cabinet asked for a deeper review of government assets, banks and GLCs. Agriculture Minister Mohamad Sabu said there is no food-stockpile directive and urged calm.

title.bm: Kerajaan: perbankan dalam talian selamat selepas cubaan serangan siber; Anwar arah semakan menyeluruh
title.en: Govt says online banking is safe after attempted cyberattacks; Anwar orders a full cybersecurity review

why.bm: Pengguna disaran bergantung pada saluran rasmi dan bank masing-masing, bukan dakwaan media sosial.
why.en: Ordinary users should rely on official channels and their banks, not social media claims.

summary.bm: Bank Negara mengekalkan Kadar Dasar Semalaman (OPR) pada 2.75% pada 5 Nov, seperti dijangka kebanyakan ekonomi, pada mesyuarat MPC keenam dan terakhir 2026. Segelintir ekonomi sebelum ini menjangka kenaikan 25 mata asas kepada 3%.
summary.en: Bank Negara left the Overnight Policy Rate unchanged at 2.75% on Nov 5, as most economists had expected, ending the year's sixth and final MPC meeting. A minority had called for a 25bp hike to 3%.

title.bm: Bank Negara kekalkan OPR pada 2.75% pada mesyuarat MPC terakhir 2026
title.en: Bank Negara holds OPR at 2.75% at its final 2026 MPC meeting

why.bm: Ansuran pinjaman dan pinjaman perumahan yang dikaitkan dengan OPR tidak berubah buat masa ini.
why.en: Loan and mortgage instalments tied to the OPR stay unchanged for now.

summary.bm: Dewan bersidang 37 hari hingga 8 Dis, dan agenda hari ini merangkumi analisis sampel RON95 dari lima negeri serta kesiapsiagaan jerebu kerana El Nino dijangka berlarutan hingga pertengahan 2027.
summary.en: The house sits 37 days until Dec 8, and today's agenda covers RON95 sample analysis from five states and haze preparedness as El Nino is expected to last to mid-2027.

title.bm: Dewan Rakyat: peringkat jawatankuasa Belanjawan 2027 hingga 26 Nov; kualiti RON95 dan jerebu dibangkitkan
title.en: Dewan Rakyat: Budget 2027 committee stage runs to Nov 26 as RON95 quality and haze come up

why.bm: Menunjukkan isu yang dibahas Parlimen sebelum belanjawan diluluskan.
why.en: Shows what Parliament will tackle before the budget passes.

summary.bm: Di bawah klausa 54, mahkamah boleh mengeluarkan perintah sekatan harta, selain perintah penghentian, pemulihan dan pematuhan, atas permohonan Pendakwa Raya atau pegawai diberi kuasa. Undang-undang yang diluluskan Julai ini menyasarkan penipuan berasaskan AI seperti penyamaran dan deepfake.
summary.en: Under clause 54 the court can issue property restriction orders, alongside cessation, restitution and compliance orders, on application by the Public Prosecutor or an authorised officer. The law, passed in July, targets AI-driven scams such as impersonation and deepfakes.

title.bm: Zahid: RUU Jenayah Siber benarkan mahkamah bekukan hasil penipuan sebelum suspek didakwa
title.en: Zahid: Cyber Crime Bill lets courts freeze scam proceeds even before suspects are charged

why.bm: Boleh mempercepat pemulihan wang yang hilang akibat penipuan.
why.en: Could speed up recovery of money lost to scams.

summary.bm: Sinar Harian memetik gesaan supaya Menteri Besar Ismail Lasim menarik balik suratnya kepada Majlis Raja-Raja jika krisis Negeri Sembilan mahu diselesaikan.
summary.en: A Sinar Harian report quotes calls for Menteri Besar Ismail Lasim to withdraw his letter to the Conference of Rulers if the Negeri Sembilan crisis is to be resolved.

title.bm: Krisis diraja Negeri Sembilan: MB digesa tarik surat kepada Majlis Raja-Raja
title.en: Negeri Sembilan royal row: MB urged to withdraw letter to Conference of Rulers

why.bm: Pertikaian perlembagaan peringkat negeri yang boleh menjejaskan kestabilan politik.
why.en: A constitutional dispute at state level that could affect political stability.

summary.bm: Lebuh raya utama sesak pada 9 Nov apabila orang ramai pulang ke bandar selepas cuti perayaan. Hujan lebat turut menjadi faktor.
summary.en: Major highways saw slow traffic on Nov 9 as people returned to the city after the festive break. Heavy rain was also a factor.

title.bm: Trafik perlahan di lebuh raya ketika penduduk bandar pulang selepas cuti Deepavali, hujan lebat tambah kelewatan
title.en: Highway traffic slow as city folk return after Deepavali break, heavy rain adds to delays

why.bm: Rancang perjalanan awal dan semak maklumat trafik terkini.
why.en: Plan journeys early and check live traffic updates.

summary.bm: Lebih 4,000 mangsa berada di pusat pemindahan di Selangor dan Perak, manakala banjir kilat melanda Kg Melayu Subang (jambatan Jalan Jati ditutup), tanah besar Pulau Pinang dan Taman Sri Muda. Penduduk kawasan pesisir rendah di Selangor juga diminta berwaspada terhadap air pasang.
summary.en: More than 4,000 evacuees were at relief centres in Selangor and Perak, and flash floods hit Kg Melayu Subang (Jalan Jati bridge closed), Penang mainland and Taman Sri Muda. Selangor residents in low-lying coastal areas were also told to watch for high tides.

title.bm: Lebih 4,000 mangsa banjir di Selangor dan Perak, banjir kilat landa Subang dan Pulau Pinang
title.en: Over 4,000 flood evacuees in Selangor and Perak as flash floods hit Subang and Penang

why.bm: Elak jalan banjir dan ikuti maklumat agensi bencana negeri.
why.en: Avoid flooded roads and follow state disaster updates.

summary.bm: Serbuan sekitar 12.30 pagi menahan 195 pengunjung bawah umur: 93 lelaki tempatan, 61 wanita tempatan, 16 lelaki asing dan 25 wanita asing. Polis meneruskan siasatan.
summary.en: The raid around 12.30am detained 195 underage patrons: 93 local males, 61 local females, 16 foreign males and 25 foreign females. Police are continuing investigations.

title.bm: Polis serbu premis hiburan tanpa lesen di KL, tahan 195 remaja bawah umur
title.en: Police raid unlicensed KL entertainment outlet, detain 195 underage patrons

why.bm: Menimbulkan kebimbangan tentang penguatkuasaan had umur di premis hiburan.
why.en: Raises concern over enforcement of age limits at entertainment venues.

summary.bm: Banjir dijangka di sembilan daerah Kelantan dan tiga di Pahang sehingga Rabu.
summary.en: Flooding is expected in nine Kelantan districts and three in Pahang until Wednesday.

title.bm: Banjir diramal di Kelantan dan Pahang sehingga Rabu
title.en: Floods forecast in Kelantan and Pahang until Wednesday

why.bm: Semak maklumat banjir negeri sebelum bergerak.
why.en: Check state flood updates before travelling.

summary.bm: Amaran tahap waspada meliputi sebahagian Kelantan, Pahang dan Sabah serta seluruh Terengganu hingga 11 Nov, dengan Kudat dan Sandakan terjejas dari 9 Nov. Monsun timur laut berlarutan hingga Mac.
summary.en: An alert-level warning covers parts of Kelantan, Pahang and Sabah plus all of Terengganu until Nov 11, with Kudat and Sandakan affected from Nov 9. The north-east monsoon lasts until March.

title.bm: MetMalaysia: amaran hujan berterusan di empat negeri hingga Rabu
title.en: MetMalaysia: continuous rain alert for four states until Wednesday

why.bm: Rancang perjalanan dan pantau amaran banjir di pantai timur.
why.en: Plan trips and watch flood alerts on the east coast.

summary.bm: Sinar Harian melaporkan Malaysia di tangga ke-19 aktiviti ancaman yang dikesan ketika agensi berwaspada siber.
summary.en: Sinar Harian reports Malaysia ranks 19th for detected threat activity, as agencies stay on cyber alert.

title.bm: Malaysia di tangga ke-19 ancaman siber global pada peta langsung Kaspersky
title.en: Malaysia ranks 19th for global cyber-threat activity on Kaspersky's live map

why.bm: Gunakan kata laluan kukuh dan MFA serta elak pautan mencurigakan.
why.en: Use strong passwords and MFA and avoid suspicious links.

summary.bm: Sembilan suspek berumur 16 hingga 42 tahun direman hingga 15 Nov atas kematian lelaki 19 tahun yang ditikam pada 7 Nov. Bedah siasat mendapati kecederaan di dada dan kes disiasat sebagai bunuh.
summary.en: Nine suspects aged 16 to 42 were remanded until Nov 15 over the death of a 19-year-old stabbed on Nov 7. The post-mortem found chest injuries and the case is probed as murder.

title.bm: Sembilan direman kes pergaduhan maut di Sibu
title.en: Nine remanded over fatal Sibu brawl

why.bm: Menunjukkan tindakan polis terhadap keganasan belia.
why.en: Shows police action on youth violence.

summary.bm: Seorang pesara kerugian RM179,490 selepas penipu menyamar polis mendakwa beliau terlibat pengubahan wang haram. Polis menggesa orang ramai mengesahkan panggilan sebegini.
summary.en: A retiree lost RM179,490 after scammers posing as police claimed he was linked to money laundering. Police urge the public to verify such calls.

title.bm: Penipu menyamar polis tipu pesara RM179,490 dalam sindiket pengubahan wang haram
title.en: Fake cops cheat retiree of RM179,490 in money-laundering scam

why.bm: Penipuan menyamar pihak berkuasa masih kerap berlaku; jangan pindahkan wang atas arahan panggilan telefon.
why.en: Impersonation scams remain a top fraud type; never transfer money on a phone call's demand.

summary.bm: Kakitangan dilihat memakai payung di dalam bangunan pada malam 7 Nov. Jabatan Kesihatan Pulau Pinang berkata tiada pesakit terjejas dan unit penyelenggaraan bertindak segera.
summary.en: Staff were seen using umbrellas indoors on the night of Nov 7. Penang Health says no patients were affected and maintenance acted immediately.

title.bm: Tular: siling bocor di Hospital Seberang Jaya ketika hujan lebat
title.en: Viral: ceilings leak at Seberang Jaya Hospital in heavy rain

why.bm: Menimbulkan persoalan tentang bangunan hospital lama ketika monsun.
why.en: Raises questions on ageing hospital buildings in the monsoon.

summary.bm: Menteri Besar berkata DUN tidak akan dibubarkan dan persidangan Bajet diteruskan. Ia susulan kemelut istana yang masih berlarutan.
summary.en: The Menteri Besar says the state assembly will not be dissolved and the Budget sitting will proceed. This comes amid the ongoing royal row.

title.bm: MB Negeri Sembilan: tiada pembubaran DUN, persidangan Bajet diteruskan
title.en: Negeri Sembilan MB: no dissolution of state assembly, Budget sitting to go ahead

why.bm: Menandakan kestabilan politik buat masa ini di negeri itu.
why.en: Signals political stability for now in the state.

summary.bm: Chery Auto Malaysia berkata sebuah Tiggo Cross hilang tayar selepas berlanggar dengan Myvi pada 7 Nov. Syarikat itu menggesa orang ramai tidak menyebarkan maklumat tidak disahkan.
summary.en: Chery Auto Malaysia says a Tiggo Cross lost a wheel after colliding with a Myvi on Nov 7. It urged the public not to share unverified information.

title.bm: Chery: kerosakan tular di NKVE akibat perlanggaran, bukan komponen rosak
title.en: Chery says viral NKVE damage was a collision, not faulty parts

why.bm: Susulan penarikan balik Omoda 5 baru-baru ini.
why.en: Follows the recent Omoda 5 axle recall.

summary.bm: Anwar menghadiri sambutan MIC di Shah Alam pada hari Deepavali. Zahid dan para menteri turut menyampaikan ucapan menekankan kepelbagaian dan keharmonian.
summary.en: Anwar attended the MIC celebration in Shah Alam on Deepavali. Zahid and ministers also issued festival greetings stressing diversity and harmony.

title.bm: Anwar hadir sambutan Deepavali MIC dengan hampir 3,000 tetamu
title.en: Anwar joins MIC Deepavali celebration with nearly 3,000 guests

why.bm: Menandakan Deepavali, cuti umum bagi ramai rakyat Malaysia.
why.en: Marks Deepavali, a public holiday for many Malaysians.

summary.bm: Kebakaran memusnahkan tingkat bawah sebuah restoran di Brickfields.
summary.en: The fire gutted the ground floor of an eatery in Brickfields.

title.bm: Kebakaran musnahkan restoran di Brickfields pagi Deepavali, dua wanita dihantar ke hospital
title.en: Fire razes Brickfields eatery on Deepavali morning, two women taken to hospital

why.bm: Semak keselamatan kebakaran di rumah dan kedai ketika musim perayaan.
why.en: Check fire safety at home and shops during festivities.

summary.bm: Perlanggaran dua kereta di simpang Melaka menimbulkan persoalan sama ada konvoi BN diberi keutamaan. Punca belum disahkan.
summary.en: A two-car collision at a Melaka junction has drawn questions on whether a BN convoy was given priority. No cause has been confirmed.

title.bm: Perlanggaran di lampu isyarat Melaka timbulkan persoalan konvoi BN
title.en: Melaka traffic-light collision sparks questions over a BN convoy

why.bm: Belum disahkan; tunggu penemuan polis.
why.en: Unconfirmed; await police findings.

summary.bm: QuickCheck The Star menilai dakwaan itu palsu. Mohamad Sabu berkata kerajaan belum sampai ke tahap itu dan menasihati orang ramai tidak membeli panik, dengan stok beras cukup enam bulan dan bekalan ikan beku terjamin lapan bulan; Fomca sebelum ini menyarankan pengguna menyimpan bekalan 72 jam sebagai langkah berjaga-jaga.
summary.en: The Star's QuickCheck rates the claim false. Mohamad Sabu said the government has not reached that stage and advised against panic buying, saying rice stocks last six months and frozen fish supply is assured for eight months; Fomca had advised consumers to keep 72 hours of supplies as a precaution.

title.bm: QuickCheck: tiada arahan kerajaan simpan stok makanan tiga hari
title.en: QuickCheck: no government order to stockpile three days of food

why.bm: Elak membeli panik dan semak dakwaan dengan sumber rasmi.
why.en: Avoid panic buying and check claims against official sources.

summary.bm: The Star melaporkan limpahan trafik Deepavali di Lebuhraya Utara-Selatan pada 7 Nov. Jalan Batu Arang-Ijok juga ditutup dua hala selepas tanah runtuh.
summary.en: The Star reported a heavy Deepavali exodus on the North-South Expressway on Nov 7. Roads such as Jalan Batu Arang-Ijok were also closed both ways after a landslide.

title.bm: Kesesakan balik kampung Deepavali di Lebuhraya Utara-Selatan
title.en: Deepavali balik kampung rush builds on the North-South Expressway

why.bm: Semak keadaan trafik sebelum bertolak.
why.en: Check traffic updates before leaving.

summary.bm: Dalam satu daripada tiga pertikaian, tribunal mengawardkan RM2,000 dengan faedah 8% dan mendapati Auto Accept serta Fast Cancel melanggar Akta Pekerja Gig 2025. Dalam kes lain, penyahaktifan seorang pemandu atas salah laku disahkan.
summary.en: In one of three disputes the tribunal awarded RM2,000 with 8% interest and found Auto Accept and Fast Cancel breached the Gig Workers Act 2025. In another it upheld a driver's deactivation over misconduct.

title.bm: Tribunal Pekerja Gig putuskan auto-accept GrabCar langgar hak pemandu
title.en: Gig Workers Tribunal rules GrabCar's auto-accept breaches drivers' rights

why.bm: Ujian awal undang-undang pekerja gig baharu bagi pemandu e-hailing.
why.en: An early test of the new gig-worker law for e-hailing drivers.

summary.bm: Chow Kon Yeow berkata Suruhanjaya Siasatan Negeri akan diputuskan selepas DOSH menyiapkan siasatan tanah runtuh 25 Okt yang meragut seorang lelaki. Kawasan itu belum diisytiharkan selamat dan kepulangan penduduk belum diputuskan.
summary.en: Chow Kon Yeow said a State Commission of Inquiry will be decided only after DOSH finishes its probe of the Oct 25 landslide that killed one man. The area has not been declared safe and residents' return is undecided.

title.bm: Pulau Pinang putuskan siasatan selepas siasatan DOSH tanah runtuh Paya Terubong
title.en: Penang to decide on inquiry after Paya Terubong landslide probe

why.bm: Keselamatan pembangunan lereng bukit terus diberi perhatian.
why.en: Hillside-development safety stays in focus.

summary.bm: Sebuah kereta tergelincir dan terhempas di lebuh raya PLUS berhampiran Tanjong Malim, meragut dua adik-beradik tiri. Hujan lebat menjadikan lebuh raya licin.
summary.en: A car skidded and crashed on the PLUS highway near Tanjong Malim, killing two step-sisters. Heavy rain has made highways slippery.

title.bm: Dua adik-beradik tiri maut kemalangan di PLUS berhampiran Tanjong Malim
title.en: Two step-sisters killed in PLUS crash near Tanjong Malim

why.bm: Pandu perlahan dan jaga jarak ketika hujan.
why.en: Drive slowly and keep distance in the rain.

summary.bm: Menteri Dalam Negeri menggesa perkongsian data antara agensi, dan The Star melaporkan pendekatan pelbagai kementerian diperlukan bagi keselamatan sekolah.
summary.en: The Home Minister called for data sharing among agencies, and The Star reported a multi-ministerial approach is needed on school security.

title.bm: Saifuddin mahu sekolah, polis dan agensi kesihatan kongsi data pelajar berisiko
title.en: Saifuddin wants schools, police and health agencies to share data on at-risk students

why.bm: Menyasarkan bantuan awal untuk pelajar berisiko.
why.en: Targets early help for students at risk.

summary.bm: Polis mengesyaki tangkapan di Hong Kong berkait dengan sindiket yang ditumpaskan di Malaysia.
summary.en: Police suspect the arrest in Hong Kong is tied to a syndicate busted in Malaysia.

title.bm: Bukit Aman: tangkapan kokain di lapangan terbang Hong Kong dikaitkan tumpasan dadah Malaysia
title.en: Bukit Aman: Hong Kong airport cocaine arrest linked to Malaysian drug bust

why.bm: Menunjukkan jangkauan rentas sempadan sindiket dadah.
why.en: Shows cross-border reach of drug syndicates.

summary.bm: Jabatan itu mengutip kompaun RM91.78 juta setakat 31 Okt.
summary.en: The department collected RM91.78 million in compounds as at Oct 31.

title.bm: Jabatan Imigresen kutip kompaun RM91.78 juta
title.en: Immigration Dept records RM91.78m in compound collections

why.bm: Menunjukkan penguatkuasaan kesalahan imigresen.
why.en: Shows enforcement against immigration offences.

summary.bm: Dana negeri itu menyasarkan syarikat pemula dan penggunaan AI.
summary.en: The state fund targets start-ups and AI adoption.

title.bm: Pulau Pinang peruntuk RM4.5 juta untuk pemula, AI dan ekonomi digital
title.en: Penang sets aside RM4.5m for start-ups, AI adoption and digital economy

why.bm: Berpotensi mewujudkan pekerjaan teknologi di utara.
why.en: Possible new tech jobs in the north.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan pada 7 Nov bahawa Fasa 1 Laluan Rel Pantai Timur (ECRL) telah siap.
summary.en: Malay Mail reported on Nov 7 that Phase 1 of the East Coast Rail Link is complete.

title.bm: ECRL Fasa 1 siap, sasar pelancaran 12 Dis
title.en: ECRL Phase 1 complete, on track for Dec 12 launch

why.bm: Pilihan kereta api baharu di pantai timur.
why.en: New east-coast rail option for travellers.

summary.bm: Brent ditutup pada $98.32 minggu ini, turun lebih 16%, selepas Brent Januari ditutup pada $93.52 pada 4 Nov atas jangkaan perjanjian AS-Iran. Iran melaporkan lebih banyak serangan ke atas kapal tangki di Hormuz dan harga melantun ke kira-kira $99.90 pada 6 Nov. Brent sekitar $97.67 pada 9 Nov, turun 0.6%, apabila Trump menyifatkan serangan baharu ke atas Iran 'sangat tidak mungkin' jika perjanjian kukuh ditandatangani.
summary.en: Brent settled the week at $98.32, down more than 16%, after January Brent closed at $93.52 on Nov 4 on bets of a US-Iran deal. Iran reported more tanker attacks in Hormuz and prices bounced to about $99.90 on Nov 6. Brent was about $97.67 on Nov 9, down 0.6%, as Trump called renewed Iran strikes 'highly unlikely' if a strong deal is signed.

title.bm: Brent tutup minggu hampir $98 selepas penurunan mingguan terbesar sejak 2020, tetapi serangan Hormuz kekalkan turun naik
title.en: Brent ends the week near $98 after its biggest weekly fall since 2020, but Hormuz attacks keep it volatile

why.bm: Minyak mempengaruhi kos subsidi bahan api dan inflasi di Malaysia.
why.en: Oil drives fuel subsidy costs and inflation in Malaysia.

summary.bm: Selepas menguasai Kongres, Demokrat dilaporkan menyediakan siasatan pengawasan terhadap Elon Musk, penasihat Rumah Putih Stephen Miller dan syarikat-syarikat, menurut laporan Rappler. Butiran masa dan skop belum disahkan.
summary.en: After taking Congress, Democrats are preparing oversight probes of Elon Musk, White House adviser Stephen Miller and corporations, according to Rappler's report. Details of timing and scope have not been confirmed.

title.bm: Demokrat rancang siasatan terhadap Musk, Miller dan syarikat besar selepas kemenangan pilihan raya separuh penggal
title.en: Democrats plan investigations of Musk, Miller and big business after midterm win

why.bm: Petanda Washington lebih mencabar untuk dasar Trump dan hubungan teknologi/perniagaan AS.
why.en: Signals a harder Washington for Trump policy and US tech/business ties.

summary.bm: Pegawai kanan AS dan China membangkitkan kebimbangan perdagangan dan AS meminta Beijing mematuhi komitmen perjanjian dagang Busan. APEC diadakan di Shenzhen dan gencatan perdagangan menghadapi tarikh akhir Januari.
summary.en: Senior US and Chinese officials raised trade concerns and the US asked Beijing to uphold its Busan trade-deal commitments. APEC is in Shenzhen and the trade truce faces a January deadline.

title.bm: AS dan China bertukar kebimbangan perdagangan menjelang sidang kemuncak APEC
title.en: US and China swap trade concerns as APEC summit nears

why.bm: Nada hubungan AS-China menentukan arah pengeksport ASEAN.
why.en: US-China tone sets the direction for ASEAN exporters.

summary.bm: Seorang lelaki Poland berusia 24 tahun membunuh enam orang dan mencederakan kira-kira 15 lain pada 7 Nov sebelum ditembak polis; tiga ahli keluarganya ditemui mati di rumah. PM Tusk menyifatkannya keganasan dan Poland mengadakan dua hari berkabung bermula 8 Nov, manakala Anwar mengecam serangan itu.
summary.en: A 24-year-old Polish gunman killed six and wounded about 15 on Nov 7 before police shot him; three relatives were found dead at the family home. PM Tusk called it terrorism and Poland began two days of mourning on Nov 8, while Anwar condemned the attack.

title.bm: Lelaki berfahaman ekstrem kanan bunuh enam orang di Dataran Utama Krakow
title.en: Gunman with far-right views kills six in Krakow's Main Square

why.bm: Menimbulkan kebimbangan terhadap keganasan ekstrem kanan di Eropah.
why.en: Raises concern over far-right violence in Europe.

summary.bm: Klaas Knot dan Pablo Hernandez de Cos dinamakan sebagai calon untuk mengetuai Bank Pusat Eropah.
summary.en: Klaas Knot and Pablo Hernandez de Cos have been named as candidates to lead the European Central Bank.

title.bm: Calon Belanda dan Sepanyol bersaing menggantikan Lagarde di ECB
title.en: Dutch and Spanish candidates to vie to succeed ECB's Lagarde

why.bm: Ketua ECB mempengaruhi kadar euro dan aliran modal global.
why.en: Who runs the ECB shapes euro rates and global capital flows.

summary.bm: Nasdaq jatuh 5.52% pada 5 Nov dan Nvidia merosot kira-kira 9%, kemudian Nasdaq naik 1.1% dan S&P 500 ditutup 0.3% lebih tinggi pada 7,376.86 pada 6 Nov. Pekerjaan Oktober meningkat 165,000 berbanding jangkaan kira-kira 59,000, pengangguran turun ke 4.1%, dan peniaga menjangka kebarangkalian kira-kira 78% kenaikan kadar Fed pada Disember (dipetik daripada Reuters).
summary.en: The Nasdaq fell 5.52% on Nov 5 and Nvidia dropped about 9%, then the Nasdaq rose 1.1% and the S&P 500 closed 0.3% higher at 7,376.86 on Nov 6. October payrolls rose 165,000 against about 59,000 expected, unemployment eased to 4.1%, and traders see about 78% odds of a December Fed hike (as cited from Reuters).

title.bm: Rempuhan saham AI Wall Street reda: Nasdaq +1.1% Jumaat selepas hari terburuk sejak April 2025; AS tambah 165,000 pekerjaan
title.en: Wall Street's AI rout eases: Nasdaq +1.1% Friday after worst day since April 2025; US adds 165,000 jobs

why.bm: Menjejaskan saham teknologi dan pusat data Asia serta mengekalkan kebimbangan kenaikan kadar yang memberi kesan kepada ringgit dan Bursa.
why.en: Hits Asian tech and data-centre stocks and keeps rate-hike fears alive for the ringgit and Bursa.

summary.bm: MPC mengundi 8-1 untuk menaikkan Kadar Bank daripada 3.75% ke 4%, dengan seorang ahli memilih kenaikan 50 mata asas. Bank menjangka inflasi CPI meningkat ke 5% menjelang pertengahan 2027, terutamanya kerana harga tenaga; Gabenor Bailey berkata ini bukan permulaan siri kenaikan panjang yang tidak dapat dielakkan, tetapi jika konflik tidak selesai, ia mungkin bukan yang terakhir.
summary.en: The MPC voted 8-1 to lift Bank Rate from 3.75% to 4%, with one member favouring a 50bp rise. The Bank expects CPI to climb to 5% by mid-2027, mainly on energy prices; Governor Bailey said the move is not the start of an inevitable long sequence of hikes, but unless the conflict is resolved it is unlikely to be the last.

title.bm: Bank of England naikkan Kadar Bank sebanyak 25 mata asas ke 4%, undian 8-1, dan memberi amaran kenaikan lanjut mungkin jika konflik Timur Tengah berterusan
title.en: Bank of England raises Bank Rate to 4% by 25bp, 8-1 vote, and warns more hikes possible if the Middle East conflict persists

why.bm: Menunjukkan inflasi didorong tenaga memaksa bank pusat mengetatkan dasar; pasaran bertindak balas sedikit kerana ia sudah dijangka (FTSE 100 kira-kira +0.6%).
why.en: Shows energy-driven inflation is forcing central banks to tighten; markets reacted little as it was expected (FTSE 100 about +0.6%).

summary.bm: Trump berkata perang Iran sebahagian punca kekalahan partinya dan 'sebahagian besarnya benar' ia menaikkan harga petrol, walaupun beliau memberitahu WSJ akan melakukannya lagi. Vance berkata 'sebab kami kalah ialah perang', dan Schumer mencadangkan penggunaan pembiayaan kerajaan untuk menekan penamatan perang. CBS dan CNN melaporkan Trump menimbang sama ada Setiausaha Pertahanan Hegseth patut kekal, yang dinafikan Rumah Putih.
summary.en: Trump said the Iran war was part of his party's losses and that it was 'largely true' it pushed up gasoline prices, though he told the WSJ he would do it again. Vance said 'the reason we lost is the war', and Schumer floated using government funding to press for an end. CBS and CNN report Trump is weighing whether Defense Secretary Hegseth should stay, which the White House denies.

title.bm: Demokrat kuasai Kongres apabila Trump dan Vance kaitkan kekalahan dengan perang Iran; Schumer kata perang mesti tamat
title.en: Democrats take Congress as Trump and Vance link the loss to the Iran war; Schumer says the war must end

why.bm: Kongres Demokrat boleh melambatkan tarif dan pembiayaan perang, membentuk risiko perdagangan dan minyak untuk Malaysia.
why.en: A Democratic Congress can slow tariffs and war funding, which shapes trade and oil risk for Malaysia.

summary.bm: PMI pembuatan rasmi China turun kepada 49.3 pada Oktober daripada 50.1, kembali menguncup, dan PMI bukan pembuatan menyusut kepada 49.7, manakala tolok swasta RatingDog kekal 52.0. CSI 300 jatuh 8.5% pada Oktober selepas rekod 12 minggu berturut-turut kerugian. Mulai 2 Nov PBOC melaksanakan repo berbalik semalaman harian pada 1.25%, dan Cailian melaporkan pengawal selia akan membincangkan sokongan pasaran saham, tanpa pengesahan rasmi.
summary.en: China's official manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3 in October from 50.1, back in contraction, and the non-manufacturing PMI slipped to 49.7, while the private RatingDog gauge held at 52.0. The CSI 300 fell 8.5% in October after a record 12 straight weekly losses. From Nov 2 the PBOC is running daily overnight reverse repos at 1.25%, and Cailian reported regulators would discuss stock support, with no official confirmation.

title.bm: Aktiviti kilang China menguncup semula dan saham memasuki pasaran menurun ketika PBOC beralih kepada kadar semalaman
title.en: China's factory activity shrinks again and stocks enter a bear market as the PBOC shifts toward an overnight rate

why.bm: China rakan dagang terbesar Malaysia, jadi permintaan yang lemah di sana memberi kesan kepada eksport, minyak sawit dan harga komoditi.
why.en: China is Malaysia's largest trading partner, so weaker demand there matters for exports, palm oil and commodity prices.

summary.bm: KKM masih menunggu keputusan makmal aduan berkaitan Gardenia Original Classic White Bread dan Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. Penjejakan terhad kerana butiran kelompok dan tarikh luput tidak lengkap.
summary.en: KKM is awaiting lab results on complaints tied to Gardenia Original Classic White Bread and Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. Tracing is limited because batch and expiry details were incomplete.

title.bm: Malaysia: KKM siasat dakwaan sakit selepas makan produk Gardenia
title.en: Malaysia: KKM probes illness claims linked to Gardenia bread and snacks

why.bm: Nota keselamatan: simpan bungkusan dan lapor gejala kepada KKM; tiada penarikan balik diumumkan.
why.en: Safety note: keep the packaging and report symptoms to KKM; no recall announced.

summary.bm: Kiraan terkini CIDRAP ialah 10,444 kes dan 5,376 kematian (5,372 di DRC, masing-masing dua di Kenya dan Uganda), kadar kematian 51.6%, tertumpu di Ituri dan Kivu Utara. Penjejakan kontak masih terhad dan tiada vaksin atau rawatan diluluskan untuk strain Bundibugyo. Pada 4 Nov WHO menyokong dua lagi calon vaksin (ChAdOx1 Oxford dan mRNA-1469 Moderna) untuk ujian Tumaini di Ituri, menunggu kelulusan kebangsaan; keputusan dijangka awal 2027.
summary.en: CIDRAP's latest tally is 10,444 cases and 5,376 deaths (5,372 in DRC, two each in Kenya and Uganda), a fatality rate of 51.6%, centred on Ituri and North Kivu. Contact tracing remains limited and there is no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. On Nov 4 WHO backed two more candidate vaccines (Oxford ChAdOx1 and Moderna mRNA-1469) for the Tumaini trial in Ituri, pending national approvals; trial results are expected in early 2027.

title.bm: Ebola (Bundibugyo) di DRC: 5,376 kematian dan 10,444 kes ketika wabak memasuki bulan ketujuh
title.en: Ebola (Bundibugyo) in DRC: 5,376 deaths and 10,444 cases as outbreak enters seventh month

why.bm: Risiko kepada Malaysia rendah, tetapi pelancong ke Afrika Tengah/Timur perlu ikut nasihat kesihatan, elak kontak dengan orang sakit dan lapor demam selepas pulang. WHO menasihatkan agar tiada sekatan perjalanan atau perdagangan.
why.en: Risk to Malaysia is low, but travellers to Central/East Africa should follow health advisories, avoid contact with sick people and report fever after return. WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions.

summary.bm: Dua kes disahkan klade 1 dan dua lagi disyaki menunggu analisis; tiga pesakit berkata mereka tidak keluar dari daerah itu setahun lalu. Klade 1 mempunyai kadar kematian dilaporkan 1% hingga 10%, berbanding 1% hingga 4% bagi klade 2.
summary.en: Two cases are confirmed clade 1 and two are suspected pending analysis; three patients say they did not leave the county in the past year. Clade 1 has a reported fatality rate of 1% to 10%, versus 1% to 4% for clade 2.

title.bm: California siasat empat kes mpox klade 1 di Stanislaus County, tiga tanpa sejarah perjalanan
title.en: California investigates four clade 1 mpox cases in Stanislaus County, three with no travel

why.bm: Penularan tempatan menunjukkan jangkitan tidak dikesan; elak sentuhan rapat dengan orang berruam dan dapatkan rawatan awal jika bergejala.
why.en: Local spread suggests undetected transmission; avoid close contact with anyone with a rash and seek care early if symptoms appear.

summary.bm: CIDRAP berkata Kenya mencatat kematian kedua manakala Nigeria berusaha memahami penularan pesakit indeksnya. WHO merekodkan 9 kes di Kenya setakat 20 Okt.
summary.en: CIDRAP says Kenya has a second death while Nigeria races to understand transmission of its index patient. WHO counted 9 Kenyan cases as of Oct 20.

title.bm: Kenya laporkan kematian Ebola kedua, Nigeria siasat punca jangkitan pesakit pertama
title.en: Kenya reports second Ebola death as Nigeria probes how its first patient was infected

why.bm: Pelancong ke Afrika Timur/Barat perlu ikut nasihat kesihatan dan melapor demam selepas pulang.
why.en: Travellers to East/West Africa should follow advisories and report fever after return.

summary.bm: CDC merekodkan 4,852 kes disahkan di AS setakat 30 Okt, paling banyak dalam 35 tahun. Seorang kanak-kanak meninggal di Lewis County, New York (210 kes negeri), manakala Pennsylvania mencatat 1,433 kes dengan lima kematian tahun ini.
summary.en: The CDC counted 4,852 confirmed US cases as of Oct 30, the most in 35 years. A child died in Lewis County, New York (210 state cases), and Pennsylvania has 1,433 cases with five deaths this year.

title.bm: Kes campak AS lebih 4,850; New York laporkan kematian kanak-kanak pertama dalam 30 tahun
title.en: US measles passes 4,850 cases; New York reports first child death in 30 years

why.bm: Semak rekod vaksin MMR kanak-kanak sebelum melancong, terutamanya ke AS.
why.en: Check children's MMR records before travelling, especially to the US.

summary.bm: Media Iran melaporkan letupan di Pulau Qeshm serta Jask, Sirik dan Bandar Abbas. AS mengumumkan Pasukan Petugas Iron Gate dan pelan menyekat laluan bekalan darat Iran, memperluas sekatan laut yang telah berlarutan berbulan-bulan. AFP melaporkan Trump kini menyifatkan kembalinya perang dengan Iran 'sangat tidak mungkin' (9 Nov).
summary.en: Iranian media reported blasts on Qeshm Island and at Jask, Sirik and Bandar Abbas. The US announced Task Force Iron Gate and a plan to block Iran's land supply routes, widening its months-long naval blockade. AFP reports Trump now calls a resumption of war with Iran 'highly unlikely' (Nov 9).

title.bm: Letupan di Hormuz ketika Iran menilai cadangan Qatar; Trump: serangan semula 'sangat tidak mungkin' jika rundingan maju
title.en: Explosions in Hormuz as Iran reviews Qatari proposals; Trump says renewed attacks 'highly unlikely' if talks progress

why.bm: Hormuz menentukan harga minyak dan kos perkapalan untuk Malaysia.
why.en: Hormuz decides oil prices and shipping costs for Malaysia.

summary.bm: Menurut Israel Hayom yang memetik diplomat tanpa nama, cadangan Qatar akan membuka semula Hormuz dan menamatkan sekatan AS sebagai ganti penghentian serangan ke atas kapal Teluk, dengan AS$8 bilion dana Iran dilepaskan. Beberapa pegawai kanan AS dilaporkan menentang dan Trump dikatakan ragu-ragu; belum disahkan secara rasmi.
summary.en: Per Israel Hayom citing unnamed diplomats, a Qatari proposal would reopen Hormuz and lift the US blockade in return for an end to attacks on Gulf shipping, with $8bn of Iranian funds unfrozen. Several senior US officials reportedly oppose it and Trump is said to be sceptical; unconfirmed officially.

title.bm: Trump bertemu PM Qatar ketika laporan perjanjian Hormuz membabitkan pelepasan AS$8 bilion dana Iran
title.en: Trump to meet Qatar's PM as a reported Hormuz deal would unfreeze $8bn of Iranian funds

why.bm: Perjanjian akan meredakan tekanan harga minyak dan bahan api; kegagalan berisiko serangan semula.
why.en: A deal would ease oil and fuel-price pressure; failure risks renewed attacks.

summary.bm: Arab Saudi berkata pertahanan udara memusnahkan dua peluru berpandu balistik ke arah Riyadh dan serpihan merosakkan ringan bangunan Aramco tanpa korban. PBB berkata lebih 1,600 terbunuh dan 300,000 terpaksa berpindah sejak gencatan 2022 runtuh pada Julai.
summary.en: Saudi Arabia said its air defences destroyed two ballistic missiles fired at Riyadh and debris lightly damaged an Aramco building, with no casualties. The UN says over 1,600 people have been killed and 300,000 displaced since the 2022 truce collapsed in July.

title.bm: Peluru berpandu Houthi dilancarkan ke Riyadh, menara Aramco disasarkan
title.en: Houthi missiles fired at Riyadh as an Aramco tower is targeted

why.bm: Meluaskan konflik Teluk dan mengancam infrastruktur minyak.
why.en: Widens the Gulf conflict and threatens oil infrastructure.

summary.bm: Times of Israel melaporkan Eisenkot diberi mandat membentuk kerajaan dan berkata tugas itu memerlukan langkah kreatif dan luar biasa. Penunjuk perasaan di Tel Aviv juga berhimpun pada 7 Nov berhubung siasatan Shin Bet terhadap pilihan raya.
summary.en: Times of Israel reports Eisenkot has been given the mandate to form a government, saying the task needs creative, unconventional moves. Tel Aviv protesters also rallied on Nov 7 over a Shin Bet election probe.

title.bm: Eisenkot diberi mandat membentuk kerajaan Israel
title.en: Eisenkot gets mandate to form Israel's next government

why.bm: Hasil gabungan mempengaruhi dasar Gaza dan Iran.
why.en: The coalition outcome shapes Gaza and Iran policy.

summary.bm: Kementerian Tenaga Arab Saudi berkata satu projektil dipintas dan serpihan yang jatuh terkena bangunan Aramco di Riyadh, ketika pertempuran dengan Houthi.
summary.en: Saudi Arabia's Energy Ministry said a projectile was intercepted and falling shrapnel hit an Aramco building in Riyadh, amid fighting with the Houthis.

title.bm: Bangunan Saudi Aramco di Riyadh rosak akibat serpihan selepas projektil dari Yemen ditembak jatuh
title.en: Saudi Aramco building in Riyadh damaged by shrapnel after projectile from Yemen shot down

why.bm: Serangan berhampiran kemudahan minyak Teluk meningkatkan risiko harga minyak dan perkapalan.
why.en: Attacks near Gulf oil facilities feed oil-price and shipping risk.

summary.bm: Liputan langsung Fox News melaporkan arahan AS mengganggu laluan pengangkutan darat Iran, memperluas sekatan laut. Houthi mendakwa serangan udara Saudi membunuh puluhan orang; dakwaan itu belum disahkan secara bebas.
summary.en: Fox News live coverage reports a US order to disrupt Iranian ground-transport routes, widening the naval blockade. The Houthis say Saudi air strikes killed dozens; the claim is not independently verified.

title.bm: Trump arah sekatan pengangkutan darat Iran ketika Houthi dakwa serangan udara Saudi membunuh puluhan
title.en: Trump orders blockade on Iranian ground transport as Houthis claim Saudi air strikes killed dozens

why.bm: Eskalasi Teluk yang meluas mengekalkan risiko minyak dan perkapalan untuk Malaysia.
why.en: Wider Gulf escalation keeps oil and shipping risk high for Malaysia.

summary.bm: Rusia berkata ia menyerang dua stesen kuasa di wilayah Kyiv dan Zhytomyr, dan serangan peluru berpandu serta dron Selasa memutuskan bekalan elektrik di kawasan luas. Zelenskiy berkata 33 maut dalam serangan pusat bantuan Komyshuvakha dengan lebih 50 mungkin terperangkap. Kyiv, Moscow dan Washington mengesahkan rundingan peringkat pasukan di Abu Dhabi pada Selasa dan Rabu, pusingan tiga pihak pertama sejak Februari; Zelenskiy berbual 90 minit dengan Witkoff dan Kushner pada 4 Nov, mendesak peluru berpandu pemintas Patriot sebelum musim sejuk. Canselor Jerman Merz berkata beliau belum melihat Rusia serius mengenai gencatan senjata. Korban terkini serangan Komyshuvakha ialah 42 maut, dengan 33 masih tertimbus.
summary.en: Russia says it hit two power stations in the Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions, and Tuesday's missile and drone raids knocked out power across large areas. Zelenskiy says 33 died in the Komyshuvakha aid-hub strike with more than 50 possibly trapped. Kyiv, Moscow and Washington have confirmed team-level talks in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday and Wednesday, the first three-way round since February; Zelenskiy held a 90-minute call with Witkoff and Kushner on Nov 4, pressing for Patriot interceptors before winter. German Chancellor Merz says he does not yet see Russia engaging seriously on a ceasefire. Latest toll from the Komyshuvakha strike is 42 dead, with 33 still buried.

title.bm: Rusia terus menyerang grid kuasa Ukraine ketika rundingan Abu Dhabi anjuran AS disahkan pada 10-11 Nov
title.en: Russia keeps hitting Ukraine's power grid as US-brokered Abu Dhabi talks are confirmed for Nov 10-11

why.bm: Perjanjian akan meredakan tekanan harga tenaga dan bijirin; kegagalan mengekalkan perbelanjaan keselamatan Eropah dan sekatan.
why.en: A deal would ease pressure on energy and grain prices; failure keeps European security spending and sanctions in play.

summary.bm: Menteri Luar Filipina Lazaro dan Wang Yi dari China berbual telefon dan kedua-duanya menyifatkannya membina, walaupun versi Beijing menuduh Manila 'campur tangan berniat jahat'. Filipina menjadi tuan rumah mesyuarat pemimpin pada 16-18 Nov, dan Rubio berkata sidang kemuncak pemimpin Quad pertama sejak 2024 akan diadakan di Manila serentak, memetik risiko Laut China Selatan dan Selat Taiwan. Perdana Menteri China Li Qiang dijangka hadir.
summary.en: Philippine Foreign Secretary Lazaro and China's Wang Yi spoke by phone and both called it constructive, though Beijing's account accused Manila of 'malicious interference'. The Philippines hosts leaders' meetings from Nov 16-18, and Rubio says the first Quad leaders' summit since 2024 will be held in Manila alongside it, citing South China Sea and Taiwan Strait risks. Chinese Premier Li Qiang is expected to attend.

title.bm: Manila dan Beijing berikrar kekalkan dialog tetapi berbalas kritikan menjelang sidang kemuncak ASEAN di Manila dan mesyuarat pemimpin Quad
title.en: Manila and Beijing pledge dialogue but trade barbs ahead of the Manila ASEAN summit and a Quad leaders' meeting

why.bm: Malaysia berada di tengah diplomasi Laut China Selatan ASEAN dan berdagang dengan kedua-dua kuasa.
why.en: Malaysia sits at the centre of ASEAN's South China Sea diplomacy and trade with both powers.

summary.bm: Sudan mengemukakan aduan kepada Majlis Keselamatan PBB dan Kesatuan Afrika, mencatatkan 70 serangan dengan 187 dron yang didakwanya dilancarkan dari wilayah Ethiopia antara Februari dan Oktober, 97 daripadanya pada Oktober sahaja. Ia melaporkan 484 orang awam dan 176 askar terbunuh serta lebih 90% stesen janakuasa bandar lumpuh. Ethiopia menafikan menyokong RSF, dan penganalisis memberitahu Al Jazeera bahawa kebimbangan terhadap peningkatan konflik serantau setakat ini menghalang pertempuran terbuka.
summary.en: Sudan has complained to the UN Security Council and African Union, counting 70 assaults with 187 drones it says were launched from Ethiopian territory between February and October, 97 of them in October alone. It reports 484 civilians and 176 soldiers killed and over 90% of city power stations out of service. Ethiopia denies backing the RSF, and analysts told Al Jazeera that fear of regional escalation is so far preventing open conflict.

title.bm: Sudan bawa Ethiopia ke PBB atas serangan dron RSF, mencetuskan kebimbangan perang lebih luas
title.en: Sudan takes Ethiopia to the UN over RSF drone attacks, raising fears of a wider war

why.bm: Krisis pelarian melibatkan kira-kira 13 juta orang boleh merebak ke seluruh Tanduk Afrika, bersebelahan laluan perkapalan Laut Merah yang sama.
why.en: A displacement crisis of about 13 million people could spread across the Horn of Africa, next to the same Red Sea shipping routes.

summary.bm: Reuters melaporkan serangan di Bandar Gaza dan Khan Younis membunuh sekurang-kurangnya lapan rakyat Palestin, termasuk lima anggota polis. Pegawai kesihatan Gaza mengira sekurang-kurangnya 1,500 terbunuh sejak gencatan, dengan lebih 74,000 dalam keseluruhan perang, manakala Israel berkata empat askarnya maut dalam tempoh itu. Tentera Israel menguasai kira-kira dua pertiga wilayah itu dan perunding belum bersetuju mengenai syarat Hamas melucutkan senjata atau Israel berundur.
summary.en: Reuters reports strikes in Gaza City and Khan Younis killed at least eight Palestinians, including five police officers. Gaza health officials count at least 1,500 killed since the ceasefire, with more than 74,000 in the whole war, while Israel says four of its soldiers have died in the period. Israeli troops control about two-thirds of the territory and negotiators have not agreed terms for Hamas to disarm or Israel to withdraw.

title.bm: Serangan Israel bunuh sekurang-kurangnya lapan di Gaza ketika gencatan setahun semakin goyah dan syarat perlucutan senjata belum dipersetujui
title.en: Israeli strikes kill at least eight in Gaza as the year-old truce frays and disarmament terms stay unagreed

why.bm: Gencatan menjadi asas bantuan Gaza dan pengurangan ketegangan serantau; keruntuhannya menambah risiko Asia Barat.
why.en: The truce underpins Gaza aid and regional de-escalation; its collapse would add to Middle East risk.

summary.bm: E-mel Anthropic pada 7 Nov, seperti diringkaskan AI Weekly, menyatakan data terdedah ialah ID akaun/organisasi, tahap pelan, penggunaan dan perbelanjaan; kandungan perbualan, kata laluan dan data bayaran dilaporkan tidak terlibat. Belum disahkan dengan notis rasmi Anthropic.
summary.en: An Anthropic email of Nov 7, as summarised by AI Weekly, says exposed data was account/org IDs, plan tier, usage and spend; conversation content, passwords and payment data were reportedly not included. Not yet verified against Anthropic's own notice.

title.bm: Anthropic dilaporkan memaklumkan pelanggan perusahaan sebuah firma keselamatan pihak ketiga mengakses sistem dalaman
title.en: Anthropic reportedly tells enterprise customers a third-party security firm accessed internal systems

why.bm: Pentadbir perusahaan perlu membaca notis dan berwaspada terhadap pancingan data menggunakan butiran akaun.
why.en: Enterprise admins should read the notice and watch for phishing using account details.

summary.bm: VentureBeat dan TheNextWeb melaporkan model berfokus keselamatan ini dinilai 'Critical' dan berharga lebih tinggi daripada pesaing Anthropic dan Google. Laporan menyebut ia menemui 81 kelemahan Firefox berkeparahan tinggi dan membina 948 eksploit kernel Linux dalam ujian.
summary.en: VentureBeat and TheNextWeb report the security-focused model is rated 'Critical' and priced above Anthropic and Google rivals. Reports say it found 81 high-severity Firefox flaws and built 948 Linux kernel exploits in testing.

title.bm: OpenAI lancar GPT-6 Cyber, dilapor menemui 81 kelemahan Firefox berkeparahan tinggi
title.en: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, which it says found 81 high-severity Firefox flaws

why.bm: AI yang mencari dan mengeksploitasi kelemahan sepantas ini memendekkan tempoh untuk menampal sistem.
why.en: AI that finds and exploits bugs this fast shortens the patching window for IT teams.

summary.bm: TechCrunch melaporkan pengumpulan dana tambahan itu menilai OpenAI pada AS$1.25 trilion; ia juga memetik data Ramp bahawa perbelanjaan AI menyusut ketika Anthropic menghampiri IPO.
summary.en: TechCrunch reports the extra raise values OpenAI at $1.25 trillion; separately it notes Ramp data showing AI spending stalling as Anthropic nears its IPO.

title.bm: OpenAI dilaporkan kutip tambahan AS$11 bilion pada penilaian AS$1.25 trilion
title.en: OpenAI reportedly raises another $11bn at a $1.25tn valuation

why.bm: Menunjukkan aliran modal besar ke AI termaju dan sentimen yang rapuh selepas kejatuhan saham AI.
why.en: Shows how much capital still flows into frontier AI, and how fragile sentiment is after the AI-stock rout.

summary.bm: Beta khusus AS untuk pelan berbayar menyambung akaun bank melalui Plaid; Anthropic berkata Claude tidak boleh memindah atau melabur wang. Pelanggan Enterprise turut mendapat pusat keselamatan dan inference hooks yang kini tersedia umum.
summary.en: The US-only beta for paid plans connects bank accounts through Plaid; Anthropic says Claude cannot move or invest money. Enterprise customers also got a security centre and generally available inference hooks.

title.bm: Anthropic lancar ciri Kewangan Peribadi baca-sahaja untuk Claude dan kawalan keselamatan Enterprise baharu
title.en: Anthropic launches a read-only Personal Finance feature for Claude and new Enterprise security controls

why.bm: Menunjukkan pembantu AI memasuki kewangan peribadi; belum tersedia di Malaysia.
why.en: Shows AI assistants moving into personal finance; not yet available in Malaysia.

summary.bm: SCMP melaporkan DeepSeek melancarkan 'super agent' AI ketika persaingan ejen pengekodan dengan OpenAI dan Anthropic semakin sengit. Butiran penuh belum diperoleh ketika ini.
summary.en: SCMP reports DeepSeek has unveiled an AI 'super agent' as the coding-agent race with OpenAI and Anthropic intensifies. Full details were not available at the time of writing.

title.bm: DeepSeek melancarkan 'super agent' AI untuk pengekodan, mencabar OpenAI dan Anthropic
title.en: DeepSeek unveils an AI 'super agent' aimed at coding, challenging OpenAI and Anthropic

why.bm: Ejen pengekodan pesaing yang lebih murah boleh mengubah harga dan pilihan bagi pembangun dan pasukan IT.
why.en: Cheaper rival coding agents can shift pricing and choice for developers and IT teams.

summary.bm: Presiden OpenAI Greg Brockman memberitahu persidangan teknologi Wall Street Journal bahawa jualan perusahaan kini majoriti hasil. Apabila ditanya sama ada OpenAI boleh bersedia untuk disenaraikan tahun depan, beliau menjawab 'I think so'. Reuters menyatakan OpenAI sedang mempromosikan ejen Codex kepada perniagaan bagi bersaing dengan Anthropic, yang dijangka disenaraikan dahulu.
summary.en: OpenAI president Greg Brockman told a Wall Street Journal tech conference that enterprise sales are now the majority of revenue. Asked if OpenAI could be ready to list next year, he said 'I think so'. Reuters notes OpenAI is pushing its Codex agent to businesses to compete with Anthropic, which is expected to list first.

title.bm: Brockman OpenAI: kebanyakan hasil kini dari perusahaan dan syarikat mungkin sedia untuk IPO pada 2027
title.en: OpenAI's Brockman says it now earns most revenue from enterprises and could be IPO-ready in 2027

why.bm: Ini menunjukkan persaingan OpenAI-Anthropic beralih daripada pengguna ke bajet korporat dan pasaran awam.
why.en: It signals the OpenAI-Anthropic race is moving from consumers to corporate budgets and public markets.

summary.bm: Dalam S-1/A yang disemak, Anthropic menyatakan anggaran dalaman menunjukkan ia mungkin tidak lama lagi memenuhi takrifan Dasar Penskalaan Bertanggungjawabnya bagi kemajuan yang dipercepat secara dramatik oleh AI, walaupun tiada model semasa dilabel melepasi garis itu. Ia berkata tidak menjangka membenarkan Claude membina model termaju secara berturut-turut tanpa pengawasan manusia yang bermakna dan sedang mempertimbangkan kemas kini dasar.
summary.en: In its revised S-1/A, Anthropic says internal estimates suggest it may soon meet its Responsible Scaling Policy definition of AI-driven dramatically accelerated progress, though it has not labelled any current model as crossing that line. It says it does not expect to let Claude build successive frontier models without meaningful human oversight and is considering policy updates.

title.bm: Pemfailan IPO Anthropic beri amaran ia mungkin tidak lama lagi mencapai pembangunan AI yang memecut sendiri
title.en: Anthropic's IPO filing warns it may soon reach self-accelerating AI development

why.bm: Makmal termaju meletakkan risiko ini dalam pemfailan sekuriti ialah isyarat penting kepada pengawal selia dan pelabur.
why.en: A frontier lab putting this risk in a securities filing is a notable signal for regulators and investors.

summary.bm: Fahmi berkata laman web Bank Rakyat yang diurus pihak ketiga dirosakkan dan diambil alih, dan bank menyekat pelayan itu. Beliau berkata tiada kecurian data dan perbankan dalam talian selamat, manakala NACSA mencatat insiden di beberapa institusi kewangan.
summary.en: Fahmi says a third-party-managed Bank Rakyat site was defaced and taken over, and the bank blocked the server. He says there was no data theft and online banking remains safe, while NACSA noted incidents at several financial institutions.

title.bm: Laman web pihak ketiga Bank Rakyat dirosakkan; pengguna dialihkan ke i-Rakyat
title.en: Bank Rakyat's third-party website defaced; users redirected to i-Rakyat

why.bm: Gunakan hanya laman rasmi i-Rakyat dan abaikan dakwaan tidak sahih.
why.en: Use only the official i-Rakyat site and ignore unverified claims.

summary.bm: Apiiro menemui 1,122 salinan awam .claude/settings.local.json di GitHub yang mengandungi sekurang-kurangnya satu rahsia; satu syarikat yang dimaklumkan mengesahkan kunci aktif. Laporan lain menyebut 2,539 rahsia dalam 1,994 repo.
summary.en: Apiiro found 1,122 public GitHub copies of .claude/settings.local.json holding at least one secret; one notified company confirmed a live key. Another report puts the scan at 2,539 secrets across 1,994 repos.

title.bm: Fail 'Don't Ask Again' Claude Code dedahkan rahsia dalam repo GitHub awam
title.en: Claude Code 'Don't Ask Again' files leak secrets in public GitHub repos

why.bm: Jangan commit settings.local.json; tukar kunci yang terdedah.
why.en: Do not commit settings.local.json; rotate any exposed keys.

summary.bm: Chainalysis berkata serangan siber agentik mendedahkan nama, nama pengguna, cincangan kata laluan dan token aktif semua pengguna. Ia menutup Reactor, Data Solutions dan API KYT dan berkata tiada bukti data siasatan diubah.
summary.en: Chainalysis says an agentic cyberattack exposed names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens of all users. It took Reactor, Data Solutions and the KYT API offline and says it has no evidence investigation data was altered.

title.bm: Pelanggaran Chainalysis dedahkan kelayakan semua pengguna dan paksa perkhidmatan ditutup
title.en: Chainalysis breach exposes all users' credentials and forces services offline

why.bm: Jika anda guna Chainalysis, tukar kelayakan dan token apabila akses dipulihkan.
why.en: If you use Chainalysis, rotate credentials and tokens once access returns.

summary.bm: Kelemahan CVSS 8.1 ini menjejaskan OpenSSH pada musl dengan PAM dimatikan, termasuk konfigurasi lalai Alpine, dan membolehkan penyerang log masuk akaun tanpa kata laluan sah. Ia dibaiki dalam OpenSSH 10.6p2; percubaan eksploit pertama berlaku kurang sembilan jam selepas penerbitan.
summary.en: The CVSS 8.1 flaw affects OpenSSH on musl with PAM disabled, including Alpine's default, and lets attackers log into accounts with no usable password. It is fixed in OpenSSH 10.6p2; a first exploit attempt came under nine hours after publication.

title.bm: Kelemahan OpenSSH 'SSHole' CVE-2026-123158 dieksploitasi dalam beberapa jam
title.en: OpenSSH 'SSHole' flaw CVE-2026-123158 exploited within hours of disclosure

why.bm: Tampal hos SSH Alpine/musl ke 10.6p2 atau aktifkan PAM.
why.en: Patch Alpine/musl SSH hosts to 10.6p2 or enable PAM.

summary.bm: Kemas kini SonicWall membaiki tujuh kelemahan pada firewall SonicOS; pintasan pengesahan SSL-VPN sedang dieksploitasi.
summary.en: SonicWall's updates fix seven vulnerabilities in SonicOS firewalls; an SSL-VPN authentication bypass is being exploited in the wild.

title.bm: SonicWall beri amaran kelemahan pintasan MFA SSL-VPN yang sedang dieksploitasi
title.en: SonicWall warns of SSL-VPN MFA bypass exploited in attacks

why.bm: Pasukan rangkaian: kemas kini SonicOS segera, semak log masuk VPN dan hadkan pendedahan SSL-VPN.
why.en: Network teams: update SonicOS now, review VPN logins and restrict SSL-VPN exposure.

summary.bm: CVE-2026-116606 (pintas pengesahan) dirantai dengan CVE-2026-111560 (suntikan arahan) memberi akses root tanpa log masuk pada perkakasan ESG. Ditampal Isnin; watchTowr menerbitkan rantaian itu pada Khamis.
summary.en: CVE-2026-116606 (auth bypass) chained with CVE-2026-111560 (command injection) gives root without login on ESG appliances. Patched Monday; watchTowr published the chain on Thursday.

title.bm: Kelemahan Barracuda Email Security Gateway boleh dirantai untuk akses root tanpa log masuk
title.en: Barracuda Email Security Gateway flaws chain into unauthenticated root access

why.bm: Pasang tampalan Barracuda segera jika anda menggunakan perkakasan ESG.
why.en: Apply the Barracuda patch now if you run ESG appliances.

summary.bm: Kelemahan ini menjejaskan WordPress 4.7 hingga 7.1.3 dan boleh mendedahkan laman kepada pelaksanaan kod semasa proses kemas kini. Penyelidik menasihatkan menyekat wp-content/upgrade sebagai langkah mitigasi.
summary.en: The flaw affects WordPress 4.7 through 7.1.3 and can expose sites to code execution during the update process. A researcher advises blocking wp-content/upgrade as a mitigation.

title.bm: CISA: penggodam mengeksploitasi kelemahan teras WordPress semasa naik taraf (CVE-2026-119977)
title.en: CISA: hackers exploit WordPress core flaw during upgrades (CVE-2026-119977)

why.bm: Pemilik laman perlu mengemas kini WordPress dan menyemak langkah mitigasi hosting.
why.en: Site owners should update WordPress and review hosting mitigations.

summary.bm: BleepingComputer melaporkan Zyxel membaiki zero-day dalam siri suis GS1900 yang digunakan penyerang terhadap hampir 1,000 peranti.
summary.en: BleepingComputer reports Zyxel fixed a zero-day in its GS1900 switch series that attackers used against nearly 1,000 devices.

title.bm: Zyxel tampal zero-day yang dieksploitasi untuk menggodam hampir 1,000 suis rangkaian
title.en: Zyxel patches zero-day exploited to hack nearly 1,000 network switches

why.bm: Pasukan rangkaian: pasang kemas kini firmware Zyxel, hadkan akses pengurusan dan semak suis GS1900 untuk tanda kompromi.
why.en: Network teams: apply the Zyxel firmware fix, restrict management access and check GS1900 switches for compromise.

summary.bm: CISA menambah CVE-2024-27834, pintasan Pointer Authentication, ke katalog KEV pada 4 Nov selepas eksploitasi aktif. Sekoia mengaitkan kempen ini dengan APT29 (keyakinan sederhana ke tinggi) melalui laman sesawang terjejas dan palsu untuk mencuri kuki pelayar.
summary.en: CISA added CVE-2024-27834, a Pointer Authentication bypass, to its KEV catalog on Nov 4 after active exploitation. Sekoia attributes the campaign to APT29 with moderate-to-high confidence, using compromised and lookalike sites to steal browser cookies.

title.bm: CISA tandakan kelemahan Apple yang telah ditampal tetapi dieksploitasi kumpulan APT29 berkaitan Rusia
title.en: CISA flags patched Apple flaw exploited by Russia-linked APT29

why.bm: Kemas kini iPhone, iPad dan Mac ke iOS/macOS terkini; ditampal sejak Mei 2024 tetapi peranti lama masih terdedah.
why.en: Update iPhones, iPads and Macs to current iOS/macOS; fixed since May 2024 but old devices stay exposed.

summary.bm: iPad mini OLED dengan A20 Pro, iMac M6 dan MacBook Pro 14 inci M6 serta MacBook Pro 14 dan 16 inci OLED skrin sentuh dilancarkan 6 Nov. MacTech turut melaporkan hasil suku keempat Apple naik 12%.
summary.en: The iPad mini with OLED and A20 Pro, M6 iMac and M6 14-inch MacBook Pro plus OLED touchscreen 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pros launched Nov 6. MacTech also reports Apple's fourth-quarter revenue rose 12%.

title.bm: Lima produk baharu Apple dijual; HomeView dan Apple TV 4K menyusul 13 Nov
title.en: Apple's five new products go on sale; HomeView and Apple TV 4K follow on Nov 13

why.bm: MacBook Pro skrin sentuh dihantar dalam dua hingga tiga minggu.
why.en: Touchscreen MacBook Pros ship in two to three weeks.

summary.bm: ProductNation melaporkan pra-pesanan dibuka di kedai Apple Malaysia, dengan ketersediaan dari 6 Nov. iPad mini OLED bermula RM2,999 (128GB Wi-Fi, tambah RM700 untuk selular), dan MacBook Pro 14 inci M5 Pro skrin sentuh dengan 24GB dan 1TB bermula RM11,999.
summary.en: ProductNation reports pre-orders are open on Apple's Malaysian store, with availability from Nov 6. The OLED iPad mini starts at RM2,999 (128GB Wi-Fi, RM700 more for cellular), and the touchscreen 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB and 1TB starts at RM11,999.

title.bm: Harga Malaysia ditetapkan: MacBook Pro skrin sentuh dari RM11,999, iPad mini dari RM2,999, dihantar 6 Nov
title.en: Malaysia prices set: touchscreen MacBook Pro from RM11,999, iPad mini from RM2,999, shipping Nov 6

why.bm: Ini menjawab persoalan harga Malaysia sebelum pelancaran Jumaat.
why.en: This answers the open Malaysian pricing question before Friday's launch.

summary.bm: Bermula iOS, iPadOS, macOS dan visionOS 27.3, fail dan foto yang dikongsi dengan 'sesiapa yang ada pautan' boleh diakses Apple untuk semakan, walaupun Advanced Data Protection dihidupkan. Pautan yang dikongsi hanya dengan individu tertentu dikecualikan, dan Apple boleh membuang kandungan atau melumpuhkan akaun, dengan keluaran awam dijangka pada Disember.
summary.en: From iOS, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS 27.3, files and photos shared with 'Anyone with the link' become accessible to Apple for review, even with Advanced Data Protection on. Links shared only with named people are excluded, and Apple may remove content or disable accounts, with public release expected in December.

title.bm: Apple akan semak pautan iCloud awam untuk kandungan berbahaya mulai iOS 27.3, menamatkan penyulitan hujung ke hujung bagi pautan itu
title.en: Apple will review public iCloud links for harmful content from iOS 27.3, ending end-to-end encryption for them

why.bm: Jika anda berkongsi pautan iCloud secara awam, anggap ia tidak peribadi; kongsi dengan individu tertentu sebaliknya.
why.en: If you share iCloud links publicly, treat them as non-private; share with named people instead.

summary.bm: Pembangun kini boleh menetapkan mesej pengekalan dalam App Store Connect yang muncul dalam aliran pembatalan, dengan teks, imej atau tawaran khas. API Retention Messaging yang berasingan, tersedia atas permintaan, membolehkan aplikasi memilih mesej bagi setiap pelanggan.
summary.en: Developers can now set retention messages in App Store Connect that appear in the cancellation flow, with text, images or a special offer. A separate Retention Messaging API, available by request, lets apps choose messages per subscriber.

title.bm: App Store benarkan pembangun papar tawaran pengekalan apabila pelanggan cuba membatalkan langganan
title.en: App Store lets developers show retention offers when subscribers try to cancel

why.bm: Jangkakan tawaran diskaun apabila anda membatalkan langganan aplikasi.
why.en: Expect discount offers when you cancel an app subscription.

summary.bm: Beberapa media melaporkan pemilik Pixel masih menunggu kemas kini November 2026. Android Authority mencadangkan Android 17 QPR2 mungkin sebabnya.
summary.en: Several outlets report Pixel owners are still waiting for the November 2026 update. Android Authority suggests Android 17 QPR2 may be the reason.

title.bm: Kemas kini Pixel November Google masih belum tiba; Android 17 QPR2 mungkin puncanya
title.en: Google's November Pixel update still missing; Android 17 QPR2 may explain delay

why.bm: Pengguna Pixel perlu pantau tampalan itu.
why.en: Pixel users should watch for the patch.

summary.bm: SecurityWeek berkata kemas kini November membaiki lebih 200 kelemahan; The Hacker News menyebut CVE-2026-58868, kelemahan kritikal yang membolehkan pelaksanaan kod jauh tanpa interaksi pengguna pada Android 14 hingga 17.
summary.en: SecurityWeek says the November updates fix over 200 vulnerabilities; The Hacker News notes CVE-2026-58868, a critical flaw allowing remote code execution without user interaction on Android 14 to 17.

title.bm: Kemas kini Android November tampal 200+ kelemahan, termasuk RCE kritikal CVE-2026-58868
title.en: Android November updates patch 200+ flaws, including critical RCE CVE-2026-58868

why.bm: Pasang kemas kini keselamatan Android terkini sebaik sahaja tersedia pada telefon anda.
why.en: Install the latest Android security update as soon as it reaches your phone.

summary.bm: Kumpulan Threat Intelligence Google dan polis Jepun mengganggu pelayan kawalan dan mengharamkan pembuat Videostrong daripada menghasilkan peranti Android bertauliah. Penutupan itu tidak membersihkan kotak yang dijangkiti, dan Google berkata ia mungkin memutuskan sekurang-kurangnya 10 juta lagi peranti yang terjejas.
summary.en: Google's Threat Intelligence Group and Japan's police disrupted the command servers and banned maker Videostrong from making certified Android devices. The takedown does not clean infected boxes, and Google says it may cut off at least 10 million more compromised devices.

title.bm: Google ganggu botnet XCPE yang menjangkiti lebih 1.3 juta kotak Android TV
title.en: Google disrupts XCPE botnet that infected over 1.3 million Android TV boxes

why.bm: Kotak Android TV murah tanpa jenama biasa di Malaysia; semak kotak anda dan pertimbangkan menggantinya jika terjejas.
why.en: Cheap unbranded Android TV boxes are common in Malaysia; check yours and consider replacing it if it is affected.

summary.bm: Diumumkan dalam Kemas Kini Sistem Google November, ia ruang khas untuk alat pengurusan keluarga. 9to5Google berkata pelancaran belum meluas.
summary.en: Announced in the November Google System Update, it is a dedicated space for family management tools. 9to5Google says the rollout had not started widely.

title.bm: Google sahkan 'Family Hub' Android dalam Tetapan
title.en: Google confirms Android 'Family Hub' in Settings

why.bm: Membantu ibu bapa mengurus akaun dan kebenaran keluarga.
why.en: Helps parents manage family accounts and permissions.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan rangkaian 5G kedua mencapai liputan 90% lebih awal.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports the second 5G network hit 90% coverage early.

title.bm: Rangkaian 5G kedua capai liputan 90% lebih awal, kata Fahmi
title.en: Second 5G network reaches 90% coverage ahead of schedule, says Fahmi

why.bm: 5G lebih luas untuk pengguna dan perniagaan.
why.en: Wider 5G for consumers and business.

summary.bm: Tesla berkata akan menamatkan pengeluaran Cybertruck pada 2027 dan menaikkan harga sehingga 10%, menurut Electrek.
summary.en: Tesla says it will end Cybertruck production in 2027 and raised prices by up to 10%, according to Electrek.

title.bm: Tesla akan hentikan pengeluaran Cybertruck pada 2027
title.en: Tesla to stop making the Cybertruck in 2027

why.bm: Petanda betapa sukarnya segmen EV premium.
why.en: A signal of how tough the premium EV segment has become.

summary.bm: Google berkata tambahan AS$15 bilion akan mengembangkan pusat datanya di Malaysia dalam dua tahun dan menjangka 37,000 pekerjaan. Anwar mengalu-alukan pelaburan itu.
summary.en: Google says the extra US$15 billion will expand its Malaysian data centre footprint over two years and projects 37,000 jobs. Anwar hailed the investment.

title.bm: Google tambah komitmen AS$15 bilion untuk pusat data Malaysia dalam tempoh dua tahun
title.en: Google commits another US$15bn to Malaysian data centres over two years

why.bm: Rangsangan besar kepada ekosistem pusat data dan awan serta pekerjaan teknologi di Malaysia.
why.en: A big boost for Malaysia's data-centre and cloud ecosystem and tech jobs.

summary.bm: Diumumkan di AWS Cloud and AI Day di Kuala Lumpur, ia merangkumi perintis GovHub untuk 500 pembangun meningkat kepada 4,000 menjelang 2028 dan Amazon Quick untuk 445,000 pegawai. PKS mendapat akses percuma Quick dan Kiro selama enam bulan selepas penilaian, selaras komitmen AWS sebanyak RM29.2 bilion di Malaysia.
summary.en: Announced at AWS Cloud and AI Day in Kuala Lumpur, it includes a GovHub pilot for 500 developers rising to 4,000 by 2028 and Amazon Quick for 445,000 officers. SMEs get six months of free Quick and Kiro access after an assessment, building on AWS's RM29.2 billion Malaysian commitment.

title.bm: AWS lancar Semarak AI Malaysia, tawar alat AI kepada 445,000 pegawai kerajaan dan 10,000 PKS menjelang 2028
title.en: AWS launches Semarak AI Malaysia, offering AI tools to 445,000 government officers and 10,000 SMEs by 2028

why.bm: Ia membawa alat AI percuma kepada PKS dan perkhidmatan awam Malaysia, bukan sekadar perbelanjaan pusat data.
why.en: It brings free AI tooling to Malaysian SMEs and the civil service, not just data-centre spending.

summary.bm: SpaceX memilih platform infrastruktur Dragonwing QRU100 dan QDU100 Qualcomm untuk Starlink Mobile, yang Qualcomm gelar perjanjian 5G terbesarnya, menurut Reuters. Kira-kira seminggu lebih awal T-Mobile dilaporkan berkata tiada ruang untuk perjanjian MVNO dengan SpaceX.
summary.en: SpaceX picked Qualcomm's Dragonwing QRU100 and QDU100 infrastructure platforms for Starlink Mobile, which Qualcomm called its biggest 5G deal yet, per Reuters. About a week earlier T-Mobile reportedly said there was no room for an MVNO deal with SpaceX.

title.bm: Qualcomm dan SpaceX bersetuju bina rangkaian 5G Starlink dengan sasaran debut AS pada 2027
title.en: Qualcomm and SpaceX agree to build a Starlink 5G network aimed at a 2027 US debut

why.bm: SpaceX sedang membina rangkaian mudah alihnya sendiri, yang akhirnya boleh mencabar syarikat telekom.
why.en: SpaceX is building its own mobile network, which could eventually challenge telcos.

note.bm: Pusingan tiga pihak pertama sejak Februari.

title.en: Apple HomeView and Apple TV 4K launch
